source_material.summary: Fictional sample committee meeting notes used to demonstrate the meeting-notes-to-action-items preview shape. No real people, no real organization.
Fictional sample organizing-circle agenda referenced by the meeting notes for context. No real venue, no real attendee roll.

proposed_artifact.title: EXAMPLE — Two proposed action items from sample committee meeting notes
proposed_artifact.summary: The parser proposes two fictional action items from the sample meeting notes: a sample working group to draft a sample agenda for a fictional follow-up cycle, and a sample working group to outline a sample obligation note for the same cycle. Reviewer is being asked to approve these as the next documented step (action-item creation) after a separate, named endpoint applies them.
proposed_artifact.detail: Action item 1: Sample agenda working group (label only) drafts a sample agenda for a fictional follow-up organizing-circle cycle. Action item 2: Sample obligation working group (label only) outlines a sample obligation note clarifying unit and provenance fields before re-presenting at the next cycle. Both action items are described in plain language; neither carries an assignee DID — holder-label to DID binding is a separate documented step under the private-overlay / DID activation flow.
